questions.question: Given that non-Anthropic models never publish cache-write prices, how should the partial-capture hazard be handled?

options.label: Forward-fill per class (Recommended) - carry the last seen rate per class
options.description: A class missing on a given day inherits the most recent rate seen for it, so a partial capture never zeroes a cost that already exists.
options.preview:
07-01: in,out,cr,cw5,cw1 present
07-10: in,out only (partial capture)
  -> cr/cw5/cw1 inherit 07-01 -> cost intact

glm-5.2 every day: in,out,cr only
  -> cw5/cw1 never seen -> stay unpriced
     (correct: no rate exists to inherit)

No model loses pricing it has today.

options.label: Require completeness, Anthropic only - emit no row on a partial day
options.description: Strictest reading, but it emits zero rows for 7 of the 14 mapped keys, permanently.

options.label: Ship as-is, alert + runbook for the on-call
options.description: No code change: page a human when a day lands with fewer classes than the day before.
